1.b4 e5 2.Bb2 f6 3.b5.strategy: Moves the pawn out of reach of the f8-bishop and claims queenside space. The pawn is now far advanced and hard to protect, so White accepts a long-term target in return for the space and a safe bishop.
1.b4 e5 2.Bb2 f6 3.b5.name: Sokolsky Opening: Bugayev Advance Variation

1.b4 e5 2.Bb2 f6 3.e4.strategy: Leaves the b4-pawn to the f8-bishop and takes the centre instead: White plays for development and open lines against the king that ...f6 has weakened. It costs a real pawn, so the gambit works only if the attack comes quickly.
1.b4 e5 2.Bb2 f6 3.e4.name: Sokolsky Opening: Tartakower Gambit
